# Evidence-bearing refusal

I cannot truthfully certify completion of the requested canonical review method.

The required single sibling-parallel Standards/Spec batch was dispatched once, but both agent prompts used the two-endpoint command:

`git diff 78cd4e9807aa8a6ebf5a0d852b096b62180fb2da 49a73c6b71683da488ec593731c23b2e834b176d`

The canonical Skill required dispatching:

`git diff 78cd4e9807aa8a6ebf5a0d852b096b62180fb2da...49a73c6b71683da488ec593731c23b2e834b176d`

A subsequent check established that `git merge-base` is the supplied base and that both commands happen to select the same committed diff, but this does not retroactively satisfy the required dispatch method. Running corrected agents would require a second sibling-parallel batch, contradicting the caller’s explicit “exactly one” constraint. I therefore refuse rather than misrepresent method compliance or violate the batch constraint.
